name: c-stepper-19

name: c-stepper-20

name: c-stepper-21

label: Security Checks

name: c-stepper-22
title: Stepper with color-coded bottom bars

name: c-stepper-23
title: Stepper with top color bars and card art
label: Top Color Bars
description: Adding a payment card in 4 steps, each tab with its own color bar on the top edge that thickens when selected, over a card drawing and a caption.

name: c-stepper-26

name: c-stepper-27

name: c-stepper-28
title: Stepper with breadcrumb steps

title: Stepper with compact inline progress
label: Compact Inline

name: c-stepper-30
title: Stepper with truck route and rest stops
label: Truck Route
description: 7 stops on a 2,890 km truck run from Memphis to Los Angeles, with dashed legs, 8H rest badges and a truck on the leg in progress.

name: c-stepper-31
title: Stepper with icon tiles and chevrons
label: Chevron Icon Tiles
description: 4 incident resolution steps, each a tinted icon tile with its title and step number, joined by chevrons, with the step's detail below.

name: c-stepper-32
title: Stepper with numbered chevron stages
label: Numbered Chevrons
description: 7 sales pipeline stages from Lead to Approval as a bar of interlocking arrows, each with a numbered keycap and the current stage filled blue.

name: c-stepper-33
title: Stepper with filled status chevrons
label: Filled Chevrons
description: 8 proposal steps as nested arrows in a frame, green with a check once finished, solid blue with a spinner when current and dashed rings ahead.

name: c-stepper-34
title: Stepper with outlined chevron plan
label: Outlined Chevrons
description: 6 proposal steps as nested arrows after a done count, finished ones outlined in green with a check and the current one in blue with a spinner.

name: c-stepper-35
title: Stepper with flat chevron plan
label: Flat Chevrons
description: 6 contract steps as borderless arrows after a done count, finished ones in darker gray with a check and the current one tinted blue with a spinner.

name: c-stepper-36
title: Stepper with shipping route and stop details
label: Shipping Route
description: 5 ports from Singapore to Hamburg, each with carrier, voyage and dates over dashed leaders, and a wave marking the leg in progress.

name: c-stepper-37
title: Stepper with horizontal step cards
label: Horizontal Step Cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as clickable icon cards that wrap to 2 columns when narrow, with a corner check on done cards and the step detail below.

name: c-stepper-38
title: Stepper with shipment progress bar
label: Shipment Progress
description: Order tracking across 6 stages from placed to delivered, with a green plane badge on the current stage and a dashed track that fills green behind it.

name: c-stepper-39
title: Stepper with vertical step cards
label: Vertical Step Cards
description: 4 incident rollback steps as stacked icon cards beside the step detail, done cards tinted green with a corner check, plus Previous and Next.

name: c-stepper-40
title: Stepper with side rail and step icons
label: Side Rail Icons
description: 6 incident response steps as rows with their own icons, a blue bar on the current row, green checks on done rows and the step detail beside them.

name: c-stepper-41
title: Stepper with status list
label: Status List
description: 6 incident response steps with a status glyph per row: a check when done, a spinning ring on the current step and a dashed circle for the rest.

name: c-stepper-42
title: Stepper with vertical status bars
label: Vertical Status Bars
description: 5 incident resolution steps, each marked by a thin vertical bar that is gray, green when done or dashed blue while current, with the detail beside.

name: c-stepper-43
title: Stepper with sub-steps in a collapsible card
label: Collapsible Sub-Steps
description: 5 ticket resolution phases holding 17 tasks, where the open phase lists its task status in a bordered box and folds away when clicked again.

name: c-stepper-44
title: Stepper with right-aligned sub-steps
label: Right-Aligned Sub-Steps
description: 5 ticket resolution phases on a vertical rail, only the current one unfolding its tasks, while Previous and Next walk all 17 tasks in order.
